rationale: The short thesis is mechanically invalidated: price has reclaimed both VWAP ($15.52) and the 9-EMA ($15.54), and the newest 1-minute candle rallied to $15.57 on ~97k shares — roughly 3-4x the volume of the prior candles — confirming the reclaim rather than fading it. With maximum favorable excursion of only 0.13% and price $0.03 from the $15.60 stop, the continuation edge is gone. I am not flipping long because a VWAP reclaim on a -2.5% gap-down day in a risk-off tape is an ambiguous mean-reversion bounce, not demonstrated upside momentum.
